findings.location: rules.md R-12, D-03; What the agent does (absent)
findings.quote: When one order is done, the customer may name another of their orders, and the agent starts over with a new proposal and a new yes.

findings.location: rules.md R-03; row 'the customer has two open orders and named neither'
findings.quote: When the customer has two open orders and says "cancel my order", the agent asks which order they mean before it proposes anything.
When the customer changes any part of the proposal after saying yes, such as asking for their other order instead, the earlier yes no longer counts.
It says the order is cancelled and refunded only when the order system shows a refund, pending or issued, for the amount and payment method the customer agreed to
The refund the order system returns carries an amount and a payment method, which the agent passes on to the customer.
